AC amendment (gap analysis — 3 clarifications):

1. LOG GROUP NAME: Use /aws/lambda/${FUNCTION_NAME} (derived from function name config key). Do NOT read a separate log_group_name config key.

2. VERSIONED BUCKET CLEANUP: Before s3api delete-bucket, must purge ALL object versions and delete markers (plain s3 rm --recursive cannot empty a versioned bucket). Use:
   aws s3api list-object-versions --bucket "$BUCKET" --query '{Objects: Versions[].{Key:Key,VersionId:VersionId}, Quiet: true}' --output json | jq 'select(.Objects != null)' | xargs -I{} aws s3api delete-objects --bucket "$BUCKET" --delete {}
   Also handle delete markers similarly. Test mock must verify these calls appear before delete-bucket.

3. CONFIRMATION SUMMARY: Test must assert stdout contains the 4 resource names before any delete call is made. Capture stdout and assert each of FUNCTION_NAME, ROLE_NAME, BUCKET, log group name appears in output before the first delete invocation in LOG_FILE.

4. dso-config.conf cleanup: OUT OF SCOPE for this story. aws-teardown.sh does NOT clean config keys. Document this decision as a known limitation in the script's header comment.

5. TEST FOR ORDERED PRINTS: Add a test case for the confirmation summary: run with --user-approved, capture stdout, assert each resource name appears in stdout BEFORE any aws delete invocation.
